title: Reading formatted interpreter errors
description: You can inspect the supplied error records and their shared display method.

steps.description: SourceLocation renders the saved source line and a caret positioned with col spaces. pretty builds a category and message, then adds the location and suggestion when present.
You can read each subclass's category property. UndefinedVar reports RuntimeError, while TypeError_ reports TypeError.
The demo constructs four error values directly. Each value already contains its message, source text and hint.

steps.question: Will pretty print the numeric line field from SourceLocation?
steps.answer: No. SourceLocation's formatter prints source_line and a caret; it stores line but does not include that number in the formatted text.

steps.description: You see four formatted blocks headed LexError, ParseError, RuntimeError and TypeError. Each block includes the supplied source text, caret and hint.
